_comment: App-UX attacker/proposer pair (prompts/app-ux-attacker.md, prompts/app-ux-proposer.md). Reuses the generic vibe-app pairing mode. Claude proposes, Gemini attacks, both via OpenRouter (one OPENROUTER_API_KEY). The pair is deliberately cross-vendor: this mode has a panel of ONE, so there is no second reviewer to catch a same-family attacker's blind spots. Gemini takes the attacker seat because this persona reads flows and screens — onboarding friction, orientation, affordances — which is pattern-spotting over an interface rather than a long chain of inference. Pass --tier to override both. Run: `node orchestrate.mjs --config agents.appux.json --task "..."` (or --file). Converges when the attacker's strongest standing finding is at/below --floor (default LOW).
